name: smart-rider-app
description: Safe Ride - Bicycle Safety Alert App

scripts.build: npm run build:config && npm run build:bridge && node build-prod.js
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:config && npm run build:bridge && npx cap sync ios
scripts.cap:sync:prod: npm run build && npx cap sync ios --config capacitor.config.prod.json
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android --config capacitor.config.prod.json
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
